sections: Next steps in the certification process
training._source: RBT 2026 40-Hour Training Requirements and Curriculum Outline, version 03/2026: 40 hours in 5 to 180 days, sections A to H totalling 38 hours plus 2 unallocated hours; Responsible Trainer BCaBA, BCBA or BCBA-D with the 8-hour supervision training; assistant trainers RBT or higher; in person or online; readings do not count.

list.name: One of: antecedent intervention, differential reinforcement, extinction

competency._source: RBT Initial Competency Assessment Packet, effective 2026-01-01, version 11/2026, form pages 4 and 5: tasks 1 to 19, assessment types allowed per task, three of tasks 6 to 14 with a client. Task names shortened by the site.

recertification._source: RBT Handbook 10/2026, Certification maintenance: RBTs who recertify through December 31, 2026 meet the old annual requirements (Recertification Competency Assessment, no more than 45 days before the expiration date) one last time, then a 2-year cycle begins; under the 2026 maintenance requirements, 12 PDUs per 2-year cycle, application available within 45 days of the recertification date once PDUs are entered; fee $50, late fee $50 during the 30-day reinstatement period.

states.name: Washington
states.techNote: WAC 246-805-300: application and fee, proof of being at least 18, proof of a high school diploma or equivalent, and proof of a current behavior technician credential from a professional credentialing entity or completion of a behavior technician training program; and the name of the clinical supervisor as proof of ongoing supervision. WAC 246-805-990: application and initial certification $95, renewal $150, late renewal penalty $75.

states.name: Oregon
states.techAuthority: Oregon Health Licensing Office, Behavior Analysis Regulatory Board
states.techNote: Application form revised 11/01/2025: proof of being at least 18, proof of a high school diploma or equivalent or a post-secondary degree, two forms of government identification; the application fee is non-refundable.

states.name: Nevada
states.techBackgroundNote: LiveScan state and federal background clearance: $40 plus the fee of the fingerprint vendor
states.techNote: Board page: the RBT registration fee of $70 is due when the application is made; fees are non-refundable; the background clearance is requested through LiveScan (electronic fingerprinting) in Nevada, results in about 10 to 14 days.

states.name: Louisiana
states.techNote: Rules Chapter 3, section 304 and 305: a Louisiana licensed behavior analyst registers each line technician working under their direction, with a board-approved criminal background check; registration $50, annual renewal $50; both parties notify the board within 10 calendar days when the supervision ends.

states.name: Texas
states.techAuthority: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
states.techNote: TDLR runs the Behavior Analysts program (licensed behavior analysts and licensed assistant behavior analysts); its program page lists no technician license.
states.analystBoard: TX Department of Licensing and Regulation

states.name: New York
states.techAuthority: New York State Education Department, Office of the Professions
states.techNote: The Office of the Professions lists two titles under applied behavior analysis: licensed behavior analysts and certified behavior analyst assistants.
